Re-planned: 101 bays on 1.80 ha; full set
100-bay heavy vehicle park with driver amenities — architectural drawing set
Great North Road (T2), Mkushi District, Central Province, Zambia · Client: Onani Investment Africa · Revision P2 — 20 October 2026
Location diagram is schematic, compiled from the client's site imagery (Images 1–6). Site centroid approx. 13.6447°S, 29.3941°E. Not to scale.
Driver amenities — roof plan & ceiling plan
Issue purpose: feasibility / credit review. Not for construction or statutory submission.
Heavy-vehicle park (truck stop) with ancillary driver amenities — no accommodation, retail or warehousing
100.0 m T2 frontage × 180.0 m deep = 18 000 m² (1.80 ha); 1.0 ha plot + 0.80 ha to be acquired
101 bays: 75 artic (≤ 18.5 m), 21 interlink (≤ 22.0 m), 4 fuel-tanker, 1 breakdown
Driver amenities 334 m² GFA; gatehouse 18 m²; entrance canopy 294 m²; pump house 7 m²
≈ 120 drivers / crew at peak occupancy + 12 staff over 3 shifts
Borehole + 20 kL elevated storage; septic tank + soakaway; ZESCO 100 kVA + genset + 22 kWp PV
Mkushi Town Council planning & building permit; RDA access; ZEMA Environmental Project Brief; WARMA borehole; ZESCO; Zambia Fire Services; NCC-registered contractor
1. Additional 0.80 ha south of the plot is secured (title, survey, change of use).
2. Plot boundary sits on the T2 road reserve line (±20 m from centreline); RDA to confirm.
3. Ground: laterite over weathered rock, presumed bearing ≥ 150 kPa, CBR ≥ 15 — geotech to confirm.
4. Site levels: gentle fall to the south (≤ 1 %), outfall available — topographic survey required.
5. Fleet mix ≈ 75 % artic / 25 % interlink & tanker — to be validated by the market / traffic study.
6. No municipal water or sewer at the site: borehole and on-site treatment assumed.
7. Kiosk operated as a tenancy (prepared food only), no fuel retail on site.
